# PIDNet-S

Semantic Segmentation · `pidnet-s_1024x2048` · DX-APP Python example

Semantic Segmentation model, evaluated on Cityscapes.

**Input** 1024 × 2048 × 3 · **Dataset** Cityscapes · **License** MIT · **Quantization** Q-Lite, Q-Pro

![PIDNet-S output](result.webp)

Full card with copy buttons and dark/light theme (open it in a browser; GitHub shows its source): [model.html](model.html)

## Quick start

Run from the dx_app root after `./install.sh` and `./build.sh`.

```bash
# from the dx_app root
./setup_sample_models.sh --models pidnet-s-1
```

**Python**

```bash
python src/python_example/semantic_segmentation/pidnet/pidnet-s_1024x2048/pidnet-s_1024x2048_sync.py \
  --model assets/models/pidnet-s_1024x2048.dxnn \
  --image sample/img/sample_parking.jpg
```

**C++**

```bash
./build.sh --target pidnet-s_1024x2048_sync   # once
./bin/pidnet-s_1024x2048_sync \
  -m assets/models/pidnet-s_1024x2048.dxnn \
  -i sample/img/sample_parking.jpg
```

## Accuracy

| Quantization | mIoU |
|---|---:|
| Raw · ONNX | 75.87 |
| Q-Lite | 75.73 (−0.14) |
| Q-Pro | 75.76 (−0.11) |
